Title: Regulatory compliance dashboard in Azure Security Center is now available

Body.Content:
The regulatory compliance dashboard in Azure Security Center is now available. The compliance dashboard continually monitors your Azure and hybrid environments for alignment to specific compliance requirements and surfaces security assessments and recommendations as needed. The dashboard also provides actionable information on steps to take to reduce risk factors in your environment and improve your overall compliance posture.

The information produced by the dashboard can be provided as evidence to internal and external auditors on your compliance status with supported standards. Simply generate and download a compliance report directly from the compliance dashboard. The report can be generated for a particular supported compliance standard and will depict a high-level summary of your current compliance status with respect to that standard. In addition, you can now automate compliance processes and manage them at scale using programmatic APIs.

Learn more
